notes: Proverbs 24:8 8 He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.

quotes.text: Because it is necessary for our development, the Lord permits the bitter to be mixed with the sweet. He knows that our individual faith must be tested in adversity as well as in serenity. Otherwise, that faith may not be sufficiently developed when a condition arises that can be met through faith alone. "… Even in times of trouble and tribulation, the gospel of Christ offers encouragement and gives assurance.
quotes.attr: El Ray L. Christiansen in Conference Report, Apr. 1969, p. 39
